name: Naturcampingpark Isarhorn
beschreibung: The Naturcampingpark Isarhorn is located in Mittenwald and sits in an alpine setting with views of the surrounding mountains. The area offers direct access to hiking trails and mountain bike routes in the nearby mountains. Nearby ski areas can be reached and used in winter. The campsite has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities with basic amenities. Guests will find a close-to-nature atmosphere here for activities such as hiking, cycling, and winter sports.
